scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid leaving rain-wet personal bow hardware sealed during the weekend field practice logistics.
Emerging Need: A wet-weather plan intersects with a prior service note showing one kit component should be dried the same day after rain exposure.
Decision Context: Drying-space labels are unavailable until the final crew count, then close quickly before the Saturday staging plan is locked.
Consequence: Without timely coordination while labels remain open, the kit may be stored damp until Monday, increasing the chance of avoidable corrosion or string-fit trouble.

parameter.title: Frostbite field practice and target teardown
parameter.description: Outdoor field practice followed by volunteer target teardown; personal bow cases will be staged with the club van during the teardown block.

parameter.subject: Saturday frostbite practice: wet-weather staging plan
parameter.body: Saturday's practice remains on. The forecast now shows steady rain, so tagged wet-kit drying mats will be used in the clubhouse hallway after teardown. The mat label sheet will open only after Friday's final crew count; untagged personal cases will stay closed in the club van until Monday pickup because the indoor hallway floor is being sealed Sunday.

parameter.content: Final crew count is in. I have two unclaimed drying mats left for Saturday wet kits; I'm printing the label sheet at 5:30, and after that the van/cubby plan is locked for anything not on the sheet.

parameter.subject: Wet-kit drying labels submitted
parameter.body: The Saturday drying-mat labels have been submitted to the field crew. No additional personal cases can be added before departure; anything without a label will remain closed with the club van load until Monday pickup.
